Checks C5, C7, and C8 apparently look for these controls in structured decision fields that the model never produces. C6's partial pass suggests its matcher is more tolerant of commitment-text wording but still failed on rollout 0's different phrasing ('parts-receipt dependency' vs 'cannot begin before receipt').
